name: guarahooks
summary: Copy-paste React hooks library with 50+ hooks, docs and a CLI installer, free and open source.
description: Free, open-source collection of React hooks you copy into your app, grouped into UI and DOM, state management, utilities, data fetching, form, auth and lifecycle categories. Hooks include useFetch, useLocalStorage, useKeypress, useDebounceState, useIntersectionObserver and useScrollLock; docs ship live demos and a CLI.
contains: 50+ React hooks, shadcn-inspired, built with React and TypeScript
categories: UI and DOM, State Management, Utilities, Data Fetching, Form, Auth, Lifecycle
copy-paste installs plus a CLI documented in the docs
docs site with live hook demos and a showcase page
MIT licensed; adding a hook takes about five minutes
